policy_cards.title: Discount percentage must be bounded
policy_cards.requirement: Discount percent must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Out-of-range discounts can create negative prices or surcharges.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Discount percent must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec bound the discount percentage?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Discount percent must be between 0 and 100
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Out-of-range discounts can create negative prices or surcharges.
audit_questions: Does the spec bound the discount percentage?
policy_cards.example_failure: Out-of-range discounts can create negative prices or surcharges.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Discount percent must be between 0 and 100 inclusive.

policy_cards.title: Final price must never be negative
policy_cards.requirement: Final price must never be negative.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Negative prices create incorrect customer charges and accounting state.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: The final price after discount must never be below zero.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec explicitly prevent negative final prices?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Final price must never be negative
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Negative prices create incorrect customer charges and accounting state.
audit_questions: Does the spec explicitly prevent negative final prices?
policy_cards.example_failure: Negative prices create incorrect customer charges and accounting state.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: The final price after discount must never be below zero.

policy_cards.title: Cancelled or chargeback orders cannot be refunded
policy_cards.requirement: Cancelled or chargeback orders cannot be refunded.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Refunding invalid order states can violate finance and dispute workflows.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Cancelled and chargeback orders must return an error and must not change refund state.
policy_cards.audit_question: Does the spec reject cancelled and chargeback orders?
policy_cards.requirement_test: Cancelled or chargeback orders cannot be refunded
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Refunding invalid order states can violate finance and dispute workflows.
audit_questions: Does the spec reject cancelled and chargeback orders?
policy_cards.example_failure: Refunding invalid order states can violate finance and dispute workflows.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Cancelled and chargeback orders must return an error and must not change refund state.

policy_cards.title: Invoice cancellation must restore reserved stock
policy_cards.requirement: Reserved inventory must be restored when invoice is cancelled.
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Cancelled orders can keep stock unavailable and corrupt inventory state.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Invoice is cancelled but reserved stock remains reserved.
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Cancelling an invoice must increase available inventory and decrease reserved inventory for each invoice line.
policy_cards.example_failure: Invoice status is cancelled while inventory reserved count remains unchanged.
policy_cards.safe_spec_example: Each cancelled line restores available stock and clears reserved quantity.
policy_cards.requirement_test: Reserved inventory must be restored when invoice is cancelled

policy_cards.title: Paid invoices cannot be cancelled by normal cancellation
policy_cards.why_it_matters: Cancelling paid invoices can bypass payment/refund workflows.
policy_cards.failure_if_omitted: Paid invoice is marked cancelled without refund workflow.
audit_questions: Does the spec reject paid invoice cancellation?
policy_cards.suggested_spec_patch: Paid invoices must return an error from the normal cancellation path.
